keyFindings.description: Doc comments omit the shutdown-drain path: listAgents' 'answers 503 for as long as that copy is a silence' (agents.go:83-84) and readRouteRoster's 'listAgents ... answers 503 with the roster's err' (issue_route_status.go:115-117); routeRoster.err says 'the listener client's own error' while the ctx.Done branch (issue_route_status.go:149) wraps the request's own end. Wording only; on the fast-follow.

The recovery half of TestAgentsAnswer503ThroughTheSilenceWindowAndListOnceTheListenerRecovers repeats issue_route_status_cache_test.go's silence-window recovery test and costs a 2.2 s sleep. Duplication only; on the fast-follow.

The drain test cancels the lifetime before the first read; a read already waiting on a fetch when SIGTERM lands takes the same branch and answers 200 (deep review's throwaway heldRosterMux test under -race; tester's binary drain case B: 5x 200). Not a defect: the behaviour is proven and the permanent test fails without the fix.

declined.finding: Move the shutdown fix into the cache (context.WithoutCancel on the shared fetch) instead of the listAgents fallback.
declined.reason: Not a defect: a design preference. The fallback is the narrowest change, keeps TestAShutdownEndsAFetchInFlight's rule, leaves issue reads' drain behaviour as at base, and the deep review and tester show it correct in every drain case (healthy, cached failure, cancelled request, hung listener bounded at 2 s).
